title: Rows as cards in lanes along a rail, one lane per value of a meaningful column (time of day, stage, day, room), with badges from related rows
about: A person's routine, a pipeline, a day's plan: each row a card in its lane (Morning, Evening; To do, Doing, Done; Monday...), its name, a short detail in the mono face (a dose, a size, a time), a muted line, badges that point at related rows (FLAGS: a query giving each row's badges, such as 'Conflicts with Iron' from the rows it clashes with) and its action on the right. Choose it over a table when the rows have a natural grouping the person thinks in; a table stays for comparing many columns.

by.about: the column whose value is each row's lane

lanes.about: the lanes in their order, as text: 'Morning:With breakfast, Evening:With dinner' (a lane's note after a colon); lanes not listed follow in the order first seen

name.about: the column with each card's name

detail.about: a column shown in the mono face after the name (a dose, a size, a time)

sub.about: a column shown muted beside the detail

flags.about: an SQL query giving the cards' badges: one row per badge with 'row' (the card's id), 'label' (its words) and optionally 'tone' (warn, bad, ok, info; warn when left out)

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows

order.about: SQL ORDER BY within a lane

action.about: the card's action words (Stop, Done, Move on)

set.about: with action: what it sets on the row, as column = value ('active = false', "stage = 'done'")

call.about: with action: a function called with {id} instead

open.about: with action: a view opened with {id} instead

empty.about: words when there are no rows

example.name: name
example.flags: SELECT d.id AS row, 'Clashes with ' || c.other AS label FROM doses d JOIN clashes c ON c.item = d.name

data.{{key}}: SELECT * FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }} ORDER BY {{order}} LIMIT 300

let.{{key}}_lanes: =String({{lanes|json}} || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s => { const i = s.indexOf(':'); return i > 0 ? {name: s.slice(0, i).trim(), note: s.slice(i + 1).trim()} : {name: s}; })
let.{{key}}_set: =(() => { const m = String({{set|json}} || '').match(/^\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*(.+?)\s*$/); if (!m) return null; const raw = m[2]; let v; try { v = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^'(.*)'$/s, (_, x) => JSON.stringify(x))); } catch (e) { v = raw; } return {[m[1]]: v}; })()
let.{{key}}_act: =row => ({{action|json}} ? [{label: {{action|json}}, onClick: async () => { try { if ({{open|json}}) return app.open({{open|json}}, {id: row.id}); if ({{call|json}}) await app.call({{call|json}}, {id: row.id}); else if ({{key}}_set) await app.update({{table|json}}, row.id, {{key}}_set); refresh(); } catch (e) { app.toast(e.message); } }}] : [])
let.{{key}}_items: ={{key}}.map(r => ({id: r.id, lane: r.{{by}} == null ? '' : String(r.{{by}}), title: r.{{name}}, detail: {{detail|json}} ? r[{{detail|json}}] : null, sub: {{sub|json}} ? r[{{sub|json}}] : null, badges: (typeof {{key}}_flags === 'undefined' ? [] : {{key}}_flags).filter(f => String(f.row) === String(r.id)).map(f => ({text: f.label, tone: f.tone || 'warn'})), actions: {{key}}_act(r)}))
